remarks: Don't be fooled! This charming single-family ranch is much larger thank it looks! Featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. This newly renovated home offers formal living and dining rooms and a brand-new eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances and stylish new flooring and lighting throughout. The finished lower level includes two additional rooms, one of which can be used as a 3rd bedroom. It's perfect for added living space, guests or a home office. Enjoy the spacious backyard & the cozy front porch, ideal for family gatherings and outdoor fun. Conveniently located near shopping centers, medical facilities, and public transportation. This home offers both comfort and convenience! It's ready for immediate occupancy.
